notes: «وكان، محمد بن جبير ذكر لي ذكرا من حديثه ذلك»: Muhammad ibn Jubayr either told Ibn Shihab the story (a link) or appears only in the scene; not added, and the text does not settle it (rule 6)
the last link is Malik ibn Aws, whose first-person words (فقال مالك بينا أنا جالس) are the saying; Umar, Ali and Abbas inside the story are not chain links
